title: Require an explicit policy before collapsing evaluator signals
narrative: Taloneth starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Taloneth refuses silent weighted blends of verifier scores and wants gates and formula version written into the result. Accepts FineEnvs reward aggregation guidance[^fineenvs-objective].
implementation: `ObjectivePolicy` and `aggregate_objective` in `mechaharness.objective_policy` record component signals, formula, version, gates, and prerequisites on every scalar objective.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.
